tasks.short: Write or modify individualized education plans

steps.what: Establish individualized education goals, supports and changes from evidence and required consultation
Write draft individualized education plan sections from the specialist's established decisions

loop.purpose: Express established plan decisions clearly in the required sections
loop.input: Source-linked specialist decision brief and approved plan template
loop.output: Draft sections with source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Specialist checks every goal, accommodation, responsibility and review date against the brief; no inferred disability, eligibility or support decision is accepted.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved sections are written manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates place fixed fields, but individualized explanation varies; the model may word decisions without making them.

steps.what: Verify and accept the exact individualized plan within delegated authority

tasks.design: Use the native individualized-plan template in {OTHER}, the pupil support record, with a bounded drafting facility only after the specialist establishes decisions and consultation evidence. {DOCS} holds the source brief; the specialist accepts the exact contribution and routes any wider approval through the existing process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Individualized wording repeats after educational decisions have been established.
tasks.enabler_now: Plan records and bounded source-based drafting are technically plausible, but the digest's plan-drafting project has no outcome results.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate supports and goals require real educational judgement and consultation.
tasks.human_edge: Ensure the plan reflects the learner's circumstances rather than plausible generic accommodations.
tasks.altitude: Reduce wording effort while retaining the educational decisions and acceptance.

reach.task: Review goals against observed participation needs
reach.learn: How to make a plan specific without inventing diagnostic conclusions

evidence.claim: ParnasSys provides pupil records, an OPP module and learning-goal tracking; the digest does not attribute AI drafting to it.
The NOLAI OPP drafting project has no reported results in the digest; this local drafting design and its savings remain E1.

assumptions: Boundary is the specialist's writing or modification contribution, including required consultation used for its decisions, excluding new motor assessment and subsequent delivery. Wider formal plan approval remains an unchanged existing team process; no extra reviewer form is added. IEP terminology must be mapped to the actual jurisdiction and institution rather than assuming US and Dutch processes are identical.

Prior assessors produce evidence and the responsible school supplies its template before s1. Students, caregivers and colleagues supply consultation input during s1. The specialist captures source versions, established needs, chosen goals, supports, responsible persons, review dates, unresolved points and consultation attribution within its 30 hours. No free approved-accommodation or complete-consultation flag is assumed; missing evidence remains a gap and is resolved manually before acceptance.

OTHER means pupil support record. Native templates and reusable approved wording come first; model drafting requires approved access for pupil data. If access, consultation or source reliability is inadequate, write manually. Overlapping consultation with adjacent discussion tasks is assigned once.
unknowns: Actual specialist authority and formal plan approval process
Approved pupil-data drafting access and real edit time
research_questions: Does bounded wording assistance save time after consultation, source brief production and correction are counted?

already_counted.description: Plan decisions, consultation and source brief capture
Exact specialist contribution acceptance and existing routing

incremental.description: Draft sampling and approved wording upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact student, plan version, source evidence, goals, supports, responsibilities and dates in the specialist contribution; changes require renewed specialist acceptance and any existing team approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+31.5+25=86.5, gross=13.5, focal upkeep=7, net=6.5. Range 0-3 allows already-templated plans, unavailable approved drafting access and high individualized correction needs.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Discuss students' physical abilities, disabilities and required accommodations with education professionals

tasks.design: Keep professional discussion and accommodation advice with the specialist. Existing evidence in {DOCS} supports an exchange in which colleagues can clarify the practical educational context.
tasks.previous_blocker: An accommodation's usefulness depends on the learner, activity and delivery constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest does not establish a replacement for reciprocal accommodation discussion.
tasks.still_hard: A plan that sounds appropriate may be infeasible or overlook the student's experience.
tasks.human_edge: Translate observed needs into usable advice and test understanding with colleagues.
tasks.altitude: Professional discussion retains its full time.

reach.task: Discuss feasible accommodations in a shared program
reach.learn: How educational delivery constraints change accommodation choices

evidence.claim: Accommodation advice depends on contextual professional exchange; no local discussion-time saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is professional discussion, excluding original assessment, formal entitlement decisions and implementation. If the same consultation contributes to a plan, count it once rather than adding duplicate baseline hours.

The specialist brings existing observations; colleagues supply classroom constraints during s1 before advice closes. Clarification and existing capture remain counted. No free accommodation-suitable or team-agreed flag is assumed.
Use existing evidence and communication first. No new tool, added colleague form or work transfer is proposed; upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual accommodation authority and practical delivery constraints
research_questions: Which accommodation questions can only be resolved through the delivery team's context?

already_counted.description: Professional exchange, clarification and qualified advice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Necessary accommodation discussion retains its time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify relevant behavioral observations, progress evidence and appropriate disclosure for the recipient
Communicate observations and progress reports, explain context and respond to questions

tasks.design: Retain evidence checking and direct explanation to students, families or educational staff. Existing reports in {DOCS} support communication; this task does not establish a new report-writing baseline to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress information needs contextual explanation and an opportunity for questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing pupil records support access without establishing that the communication itself disappears.
tasks.still_hard: Behavior descriptions can be misunderstood as diagnostic labels or fixed expectations.
tasks.human_edge: Explain observations respectfully, hear concerns and clarify uncertainty.

reach.task: Explain progress evidence to a family
reach.learn: How to discuss observed change without overclaiming its cause

evidence.claim: ParnasSys includes pupil records and a parent app; that capability does not establish replacement of progress explanation or local communication savings.

assumptions: Boundary is communicating existing observations and reports, excluding original assessment and separate report preparation. Reporting effort is not claimed again here.

The specialist and responsible educators produce observations and reports through existing work before s1. In s1 the specialist checks source, timing, recipient identity, purpose and disclosure limits within retained time. Recipients provide questions during s2 before responses. No free authorized-recipient or understood-progress flag is assumed; uncertainty is clarified manually.
Use native pupil communication facilities before adding tools. No new drafting or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual communication channels and recipient access rules
research_questions: Which progress statements need clarification to avoid misunderstanding?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Verification and recipient discussion retain their time without inventing report preparation savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Attend training, workshops or professional meetings and examine implications for adapted physical education

tasks.design: Retain participation in relevant professional learning. Session materials in {DOCS} can support reflection, but a summary does not establish attendance, practiced skills or understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professional learning includes questions, demonstrations and contextual interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied lesson tools do not establish replacement of specialist professional learning.
tasks.still_hard: A new practice may have limited evidence or require supervised experience.
tasks.human_edge: Question applicability and connect the learning to actual student needs.

reach.role: recreation and fitness studies teacher, postsecondary
reach.task: Discuss evidence behind an adapted activity practice
reach.learn: How to separate a promising idea from a supported teaching approach

evidence.claim: Participating in professional learning is not equivalent to receiving an automatic summary; no measured local attendance saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is attending and learning, excluding travel, booking and separate literature review, whose baseline shares are not established.

Trainers and peers provide material and responses during s1 before the specialist reflects on applicability. Questions and clarification remain counted; no free competency or completed-learning flag is assumed.
Use existing learning facilities and materials first. No new tool or work transfer is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Required practical training and accreditation arrangements
research_questions: Which learning objectives require demonstration, practice or peer discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Professional learning remains human work; summaries are not counted as attendance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Support plan wording after decisions are made while retaining consultation, communication and professional learning.
reach: Review individualized goals with special education teachers
Discuss practical accommodation constraints with instructional coordinators
skills_to_grow: Check plan drafts against attributed evidence
Recognize unsupported accommodations and diagnostic labels
role.ambitious_version: A specialist who spends less effort on plan wording while keeping educational judgement and family dialogue central.
